If there’s one thing I definitely noticed, it’s the lack of a remarkable, brilliant, and memorable soundtrack—the kind that used to make our hearts race and created breathtaking, climactic moments. It doesn't even come close to what *Game of Thrones* delivered. In my opinion, Ramin Djawadi’s creativity and genius were lost in *House of the Dragon*. I hope he brings something truly striking, brilliant, and magnificent to the final season.
